description: Open-source modular smart-mirror platform with clock, weather, calendar, news, and hundreds of community modules. Runs headless in server-only mode and renders in any browser.
tagline: Turn a mirror into a modular smart display.
author: WisdomSky

tips.before_install: MagicMirror has no authentication. Keep it on a trusted LAN. Edit `/DATA/AppData/magicmirror/config/config.js` to add modules, calendars, and news feeds.

title: MagicMirror²
